title: FactReview: Evidence-Grounded Peer Review with Execution-Based Claim Verification
abstract: arXiv:2604.04074v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based reviewing systems typically assess manuscripts in isolation, leaving literature- and code-dependent claims difficult to verify. We present FactReview, an audit pipeline that extracts review-relevant claims, grounds them in related work and reference checks, and, when code is available, executes released artifacts under a fixed repair budget. On 26 paper-disjoint test papers with 354 human-verified claims, FactReview achieves 84.3\% F1 for claim recovery. In a same-backend, evidence-matched comparison, FactReview scores 4.72/5 overall, outperforming a direct LLM reviewer by 0.74 points. Removing execution evidence changes 17.0\% of claim statuses, more than removing any other single evidence source. In a reviewer-assistance study, FactReview reduces mean review time by 58\% while increasing benchmark-claim coverage from 87\% to 99\%. translated_title: FactReview：基于证据的同行评审与执行式声明验证
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的评审系统通常孤立地评估稿件，导致依赖文献和代码的声明难以验证。我们提出了FactReview，一个审计流水线，它提取与评审相关的声明，将其与相关工作及参考文献检查进行关联，并在代码可用时，在固定修复预算下执行发布的工件。在26篇论文不相交的测试论文及354个人工验证声明上，FactReview的声明恢复F1分数达到84.3%。在相同后端和证据匹配的比较中，FactReview总体得分4.72/5，比直接LLM评审者高出0.74分。移除执行证据会改变17.0%的声明状态，比移除任何其他单一证据来源的影响更大。在评审辅助研究中，FactReview将平均评审时间减少58%，同时将基准声明覆盖率从87%提高到99%。FactReview支持基于证据的声明审计，并具有接受性。
tldr: FactReview通过结合文献、参考检查和代码执行的多源证据审计，显著提升了论文声明验证的准确性和评审效率。
en_tdlr: FactReview enhances paper claim verification and review efficiency by integrating multi-source evidence from literature, reference checks, and code execution.
